definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.34) defines class of a data item by 'the PICTURE clause, the USAGE clause, or the PICTURE and USAGE clauses'; §2023:3.33 says 'the specific clauses' and moves PICTURE/USAGE to a note. The operative table, §2002:8.5.2 Table 3, is §2023:8.5.2.1 Table 2 less the 2023-only class message-tag and category function-pointer, with the same group-item rules, so class and category numeric are the same; the rule describes implicit items. Scope unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: 2002 4.163 report 'A printed output described in the report section'; 2023 defines a report through the RD/REPORT clause (13.18.46). Same entity: one counter pair per RD. No change.
